measures.notes: Napa County's Measure P page (https://www.napacounty.gov/2470/City-of-American-Canyon---Measure-P) has no documents; it defers to the city's Elections Central. Documents are on the City of American Canyon Ballot Measures page as Laserfiche viewer links (not direct PDFs). No argument against is listed. The same page also lists Certified Resolutions 2026-39 and 2026-57, a Notice of Election, and Spanish versions (not verified here). americancanyon.gov is behind Cloudflare for curl.
